test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a commercial bank?

options.text: The Industrial Credit and Investment Corporation of India Bank
National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development

solution:
The correct answer is __**National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **NABARD** is a development bank established for promoting sustainable and equitable agriculture and rural development in India.
 
• It was set up on **12 July 1982**, based on the recommendations of the B. Sivaraman Committee.
 
• NABARD focuses on providing credit, refinancing, and other facilities to support rural development projects, rather than functioning as a commercial bank.
 
• Unlike commercial banks, NABARD does not accept deposits from individuals or offer regular banking services like savings accounts or loans to the general public.
 
• Commercial banks, such as the State Bank of India (SBI) and ICICI Bank, serve individual customers and businesses with a variety of banking products and services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commercial Banks**:

 
 
• These are financial institutions that provide a variety of banking services, such as accepting deposits, offering loans, and facilitating transactions.
 
• Examples include the State Bank of India (SBI), ICICI Bank, and the Development Bank of Singapore (DBS).
 
• They cater to individual customers, businesses, and corporations.
 
 
 
• **NABARD's Role**:
 
 
• It primarily acts as a refinancing institution for rural credit and aids in the development of rural infrastructure.
 
• NABARD partners with state governments, NGOs, and banks to implement projects related to rural development.
 
• It focuses on sectors like irrigation, rural housing, and agricultural productivity.
 
 
 
• **Difference Between Commercial and Development Banks**:
 
 
• Commercial banks serve the general public, while development banks like NABARD focus on specific sectors, such as agriculture and rural infrastructure.
 
• Development banks do not offer conventional banking services like savings accounts or credit cards.
 
 
 
• **Examples of Development Banks in India**:
 
 
• National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD).
 
• Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI).
 
• Export-Import Bank of India (EXIM Bank).
